_comment: Frozen from vid_1549eeacea78 (the v3 control of the first directed-edit A/B pair) on DIRECTED_TEST_01: directed-test pack, narrowed to basic's seven components, emphasis on, no practical per-minute cap. The case exists to measure one judgement — a numbered list's positions are headings, not quantities — so the menu that offered TextCounter for them is the menu it must be scored under.
content_rules: No direct address to viewer. No exclamations. No sensationalism. Facts stated plainly. Third person only.

style_pack_doc.name: directed-test
style_pack_doc.script_persona: Grave, measured. Third person. Short declarative sentences. Names, dates and places stated plainly. No excitement, no direct address.
style_pack_doc.visual_language: Cinematic stock footage of extreme landscapes and expedition activity, intercut with archival paintings and maps as exhibits with slow ken_burns; avoid modern urban footage, talking heads, and screen recordings.
